programme.title: Football (M): Celje - Maribor, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Celje - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (m): din. Zagreb - Fenerbahçe, European League 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Din. Zagreb - Fenerbahçe, Evropska liga 2025/26
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of the European Football Association of UEFA since 1971. Skozi leta se je sam format tekmovanja nekajkrat spremenil, od sezone 2004/2005 pa je uvedeno tekmovanje po skupinah, kateremu sledijo eliminacije. programme.title: Bite Science: Radioactive followers, Mon. / Ugriznimo znanost: Radioaktivna sledila, pon.
programme.desc: The Hungarian chemist and Nobel laureate Georg von Hevesy, as a young student, suspected that his housewife was preparing dishes from several days old remains. In order to prove this, he sprinkled food with a radioactive trace, and when he served the same food, he checked with a detector that he was radioactive. His suspicions were confirmed. This was the first use of radioactive followed. Today, this method is something quite common. We can follow molecules in plants, in our body, monitoring the movement of fish flocks, sea currents. Radioactive followed us reveal ways that we would not otherwise see. They can also protect endangered animals and valuables. / Madžarski kemik in Nobelov nagrajenec Georg von Hevesy je kot mlad študent sumil, da mu njegova gospodinja pripravlja jedi iz več dni starih ostankov. Da bi to dokazal, je hrano posipal z radioaktivnim sledilom, in ko mu je postregla isto hrano, z detektorjem preveril, ali je radioaktivna. Njegovi sumi so bili potrjeni. To je bila prva uporaba radioaktivnih sledil. Danes je ta metoda nekaj povsem običajnega. Sledimo lahko molekulam v rastlinah, v našem telesu, spremljamo gibanje ribjih jat, morskih tokov. Radioaktivna sledila nam razkrivajo poti, ki jih sicer ne bi videli. Z njimi pa lahko tudi varujemo ogrožene živali in dragocenosti.

programme.desc: The film tells the story of Gertrude Bell, who, as a historian, writer and member of the British secret intelligence service in the 1920s, played a key role in the formation of a new political order in the Middle East. Following a tragic relationship with a diplomat and an unwavering gambler Henry Cadogan, she decides to put her private life on the sidelines and discover the country as a researcher. While the Ottoman Empire is slowly falling apart, Gertrude Bell learns languages, translates literature, learns Muslim dignitaries in Cairo, Basra and Baghdad, and gains their confidence with his courage and respect. As a mediator between the Orient and the British Empire after the First World War, she contributes to the determination of new borders in the country. Po tragičnem razmerju z diplomatom in nepoboljšljivim kockarjem Henryjem Cadoganom se odloči, da postavi zasebno življenje na stranski tir in deželo odkrije kot raziskovalka. Medtem ko Otomansko cesarstvo počasi razpada, se Gertrude Bell uči jezikov, prevaja literaturo, spoznava muslimanske dostojanstvenike v Kairu, Basri in Bagdadu ter s svojim pogumom in spoštljivostjo pridobi njihovo zaupanje. programme.title: Mussolini - fascist dictator, French documentary series, 1/2, Mon. / Mussolini – fašistični diktator, francoska dokumentarna serija, 1/2, pon.
programme.sub-title: Mussolini, The Fascist Emperor / Mussolini, only the premier fascist; He embodied the Alliance between fascist Italy and Nazi Germany and reigned to the people as a new Caesar and the heir of the imperial rhyme. Documentary series in two parts presents the story of a duče / Mussolini, The Fascist Emperor / Mussolini, Le Premier Fasciste; Utelesil je zavezništvo med fašistično Italijo in nacistično Nemčijo ter zavladal ljudstvu kot novi cezar in dedič cesarskega Rima. Dokumentarna serija v dveh delih predstavi zgodbo o duče
programme.desc: Part 1: Benito Mussolini was born in a poor village near Venice. As a young man, he repeatedly landed behind the latch due to the revolutionary incitement. He then transformed into a nationalist. Determined to turn Italy into a world superpower modeled after the Roman Empire, Mussolini took power in 1922 after a march to Rome and introduced fascism into the country. He ruled with a hard hand, but the Italians, as well as Italian Jews, admired him, promising them the rebirth of the country. His regime was also inspired by Adolf Hitler, who became a Firer of Germany in 1933. Mussolini, The Fascist Emperor / Mussolini, only the Prime Minister of the Fascist / France / 2021 / Director: Serge de Sampignny. / 1. del:Benito Mussolini se je rodil v revni vasici blizu Benetk. Kot mladenič je zaradi revolucionarnega hujskaštva večkrat pristal za zapahi. Nato se je prelevil v nacionalista. Odločen, da Italijo spremeni v svetovno velesilo po vzoru rimskega cesarstva, je Mussolini leta 1922 po pohodu na Rim prevzel oblast in v državo vpeljal fašizem. Vladal je s trdo roko, toda Italijani, pa tudi italijanski Judje, so ga občudovali, saj jim je obljubljal preporod države. Njegov režim pa je navdihnil tudi Adolfa Hitlerja, ki je leta 1933 postal firer Nemčije. MUSSOLINI, THE FASCIST EMPEROR / MUSSOLINI, LE PREMIER FASCISTE / Francija / 2021 / Režija: Serge de Sampigny.

programme.title: Slovenian jazz scene: Lenart Krečič and Big Band RTV Slovenia, guests Gene Lake and Boris Kozlov, Max Club Jazz Festival Velenje, Mon. / Slovenska jazz scena: Lenart Krečič in Big Band RTV Slovenija, gosta Gene Lake in Boris Kozlov, Max Klub Jazz Festival Velenje, pon.
programme.desc: R: Švigelj Tomaž ... At the opening concert of the Jazz Max Club Festival in Velenje, young Slovenian jazz creator Lenart Krečič presented himself with an author's program in the company Big Banda RTV Slovenia and two music guests. The saxophonist, arranger and composer, torn between the US and Slovenia, has lived and worked for seven years in New York, a metropolis of jazz music. At a highly respected university, he completed his master's degree in improvisation, he had the opportunity to get to know and create with many giants of jazz music and perform in numerous renowned jazz clubs, including Blue Note, Iridium and Jazz Gallery. He brought two excellent guest musicians, American drummer Gen Lak and bassist Boris Kozlov, who is native to Russian, and live and work in New York to New York. The program, prepared and led by Lenart Krečič, was featured with seven author's songs written right for the occasion and performers. / R: Švigelj Tomaž... Na otvoritvenem koncertu Jazz festivala Max kluba v Velenju se je z avtorskim programom v družbi Big Banda RTV Slovenija in dveh glasbenih gostov predstavil mladi slovenski džezovski ustvarjalec Lenart Krečič. Saksofonist, aranžer in skladatelj, razpet med ZDA in Slovenijo, je v New Yorku, metropoli džezovske glasbe, živel in deloval kar sedem let. Na zelo cenjeni univerzi je končal magistrski študij iz improvizacije, imel je priložnost spoznati in ustvarjati s številnimi velikani džezovske glasbe in nastopiti v številnih priznanih džezovskih klubih, med drugimi v Blue note, Iridium in Jazz Gallery. Na tokratni koncert v Slovenijo je pripeljal dva izvrstna gostujoča glasbenika, ameriškega bobnarja Gena Laka in basista Borisa Kozlova, ki je po rodu Rus, živi in deluje pa v New Yorku. Program, ki ga je pripravil in vodil Lenart Krečič, je postregel s sedmimi avtorskimi skladbami, napisanimi prav za to priložnost in izvajalce.

programme.title: Memories: prof. dr. Niko Tosh, 4. Part, Mon. / Spomini: prof. dr. Niko Toš, 4. del, pon.
programme.desc: Lawyer and sociologist prof. dr. Nika Tosh is known by many generations of students of the Faculty of Social Sciences, and is known to the general public as the founder and head of the Center for Research of Public Opinion and Mass Communications. The first two of the four parts of the show are, through his memories and the memories of his ancestors, interesting Chronicle of Life in Slovenia in the last century on his life path from Maribor through Celje to Ljubljana, among personalities whose stories (even with valuable documentary recordings) are involved in the narrative, and are also the colonel of the royal army Draz Mihailov, Wife, sculptor Karl Bulovcev, uncle and aunt Nika Tosh, the Mrak family, from which Tosh's mother, painter and Olympian Toso Primožič and many others come from. The third and fourth parts of the memories of Nika Tosh are dedicated to the development of Slovenian and Yugoslav society through the findings of public opinion polls, and again the entire Gallery of Slovenian, Yugoslav and European figures in this field is involved in the narrative. Today, the eighty -year -old annual professor Niko Toš is an outstanding storyteller and a weighty thoughtful about society and time we live, so it is definitely worth listening to. / Pravnika in sociologa prof. dr. Nika Toša poznajo mnoge generacije študentov Fakultete za družbene vede, širša javnost pa ga pozna kot ustanovitelja in predstojnika Centra za raziskovanje javnega mnenja in množičnih komunikacij. Prva dva od štirih delov oddaje sta skozi njegove spomine ter spomine njegovih prednikov zanimiva kronika življenja na Slovenskem v zadnjem stoletju na njegovi življenjski poti od Maribora prek Celja v Ljubljano, med osebnostmi, katerih zgodbe se (tudi z dragocenimi dokumentarnimi posnetki) vpletajo v pripoved, pa so tudi polkovnik kraljeve vojske Draža Mihailovič, major Mirko Bitenc, pisatelj in dramatik Ivan Mrak in njegova žena, kiparka Karla Bulovčeva, stric in teta Nika Toša, družina Mrak, iz katere izhaja Toševa mama, slikar in olimpijec Tošo Primožič in mnogi drugi. Tretji in četrti del Spominov Nika Toša sta posvečena razvoju slovenske in jugoslovanske družbe skozi izsledke raziskav javnega mnenja in spet se v pripoved vpleta cela galerija slovenskih, jugoslovanskih in evropskih osebnosti s tega področja. Danes oseminosemdesetletni letni profesor Niko Toš je izjemen pripovednik in tehten premišljevalec o družbi in času, ki ga živimo, zato mu je vsekakor vredno prisluhniti.

programme.desc: The concert at the beginning of the new season of the Kromatika concert cycle is dedicated to the 70th anniversary of the RTV Slovenia Symphony Orchestra. In the first part of the concert you will be accompanied by the festive ceremonial overture of L. M. Škerjanc and the famous concert for violin no. 1 in G-Molo, op. 26, German romantic composer Max Bruch. The soloist will be Stefan Milenkovic, an internationally renowned violinist who has been working with the RTV Slovenia Symphony Orchestra since childhood and has also recorded several records with him. His interpretations are characterized by virtuosity, warmth and pronounced musicality. The symphonies will be led by Lio Kuewman, young Chinese conductor and leader of the RTV Slovenia Symphony Orchestra. Critics describe him as one of the most talented conductors of his generation. The transfer of the concert is prepared by the editorial board of the Television Slovenia Music and Ballet Shows, the director is Aljaž Bastič. During the break, viewers will be able to watch the music documentary sound of a rich tradition, which represents the vibrant history of the RTV Slovenia Symphony Orchestra. / Koncert ob začetku nove sezone koncertnega cikla Kromatika je posvečen 70-letnici Simfoničnega orkestra RTV Slovenija. V prvem delu koncerta boste spremljali svečano Slavnostno uverturo L. M. Škerjanca ter znameniti Koncert za violino št. 1 v g-molu, op. 26, nemškega romantičnega skladatelja Maxa Brucha. Solist bo Stefan Milenković, mednarodno priznani violinist, ki s Simfoničnim orkestrom RTV Slovenija sodeluje že od otroških let in je z njim posnel tudi več plošč. Njegove interpretacije odlikujejo virtuoznost, toplina in izrazita muzikalnost. Simfonike bo vodil Lio Kuokman, mladi kitajski dirigent in vodja Simfoničnega orkestra RTV Slovenija. Kritiki ga opisujejo kot enega od najbolj nadarjenih dirigentov njegove generacije. Prenos koncerta pripravlja Uredništvo glasbenih in baletnih oddaj Televizije Slovenija, režiser je Aljaž Bastič. Med odmorom si bodo gledalci lahko ogledali glasbeni dokumentarni film Zvok bogate tradicije, ki predstavlja razgibano zgodovino Simfoničnega orkestra RTV Slovenija.

programme.title: Sound of rich tradition, RTV Slovenia Symphony Orchestra, music documentary, Mon. / Zvok bogate tradicije, Simfonični orkester RTV Slovenija, glasbeni dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.desc: Walk through the vibrant history and development of the RTV Slovenia Symphony Orchestra. For 70 years, the orchestra has been supplementing Radio and Television Slovenia programs with quality and current musical content, and enriches the national sound and note archive. In his concert cycles, he presents and preserves superiority with collaborations with guest musicians and conductors from all over the world and supports young musicians and composers along their journey. He strives for diversity and masterfully adapts to the performances of different orchestral styles and periods, from ancient music genres, through popular, film and classic music, to contemporary avant -garde content. Part of the story of the orchestra is told by former and current members of the RTV Slovenia orchestra and music production, longtime conductor Samo Hubad and Anton Nanut, current boss conductor Lio Kuewman, composer Ivo Petrić and Aldo Kumar and singer Raiven. / Sprehod skozi razgibano zgodovino in razvoj Simfoničnega orkestra RTV Slovenija. Stremi k raznovrstnosti in svoj zvok mojstrsko prilagaja izvedbam različnih orkestralnih stilov in obdobij, vse od starodavnih glasbenih zvrsti, preko popularnih, filmskih in klasičnih glasbenih del, do sodobnih avantgardnih vsebin. Del zgodbe o orkestru pripovedujejo nekdanji in sedanji člani orkestra in Glasbene produkcije RTV Slovenija, dolgoletna dirigenta Samo Hubad in Anton Nanut, sedanji šef dirigent Lio Kuokman, skladatelja Ivo Petrić in Aldo Kumar ter pevka Raiven.

programme.title: As if it were yesterday / Com si fos ahir
programme.desc: A group of Dantics Companys Outittites, after twenty-five years, meet at the funeral dun dells. The Institute's time made them a heterogeneous, gamber and full of life group, but life was distributed very diverse to TV3 on the table, after the end of the creek, which was broadcast for eight seasons. As if it were yesterday it runs in Barcelona and the protagonists live throughout the geography of the city. The series, starring Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Labyrinth of Shadows), Montse Germán (Infidels) and Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), wants to present everyday life that can sometimes be raw, sometimes pathetic, but which can also be tender, light and even fun. / Una colla dantics companys dinstitut es retroben, despres de vint-i-cinc anys, al funeral dun dells. Lèpoca de linstitut els va convertir en un grup heterogeni, gamberro i ple de vida, però la vida els va anar repartint fitxes molt diverses.Nova aposta de TV3 per la sobretaula, despres del final de La Riera, que es va emetre durant vuit temporades. Com si fos ahir transcorre a Barcelona i els protagonistes viuen repartits per tota la geografia de la ciutat. La sèrie, protagonitzada per Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d’ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) i Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), vol presentar una quotidianitat que de vegades pot ser crua, de vegades patètica, però que tambe pot ser tendra, lleugera i, fins i tot, divertida.

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: The lady in yellow (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American yellow show, with the participation of Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. He aired weekly on the CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV-Movie, until 2003 (as a wagon read with murder, the ballad of the lost boy and appointment with death). Angela Lansbury played the role of executive producer of the show in his last seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspective writer of yellow, who often finds himself dealing with mysterious murders, for whom he always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small village, the fictitious Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of La Signora in Yellow is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the first choice of the manufacturer. The part had been initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however refused. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

The consecutive fourth. Next year, the average monthly award for compulsory basic laxing will be in Ticino of 501.50 francs, against 393.30 francs in Switzerland and 347.50 in the grays, which mark a rake of 5.5%. The Ticino is the canton with the clearly higher prize and lincrement of all of Switzerland. For citizens another blow that will further weigh on the family budget. Also because the prize had already increased by 9.2% in 2023 and 10.5% in 2024 and 2025. But how much do these room affect? What should the insured persons to make ends meet and get to the end of the month? Are there recipes to save? Patti Chiari has collected the testimonies of those who in a short time saw the annual invoice of over 1000 francs rise. Yet, to spend less, he chose the highest deductible, the 2500 francs. Until this amount he therefore pays any visits and medicines of his own pocket. Possible. Because even those who do not have or do not want to spend 2500 francs, and even less. "I go to the doctor only if he is dying," an insured told us. Refusing or giving up exams and consultations is increasingly frequent. With what consequences? And then there is those who, to save money, go to Italy, even just for a blood control. And the so -called health tourism. In short, the pressure of the prizes is to the stars. And citizens ask politics solutions. One of these is the moratorium on the opening of medical studies in 8 specializations, which entered into force on 1 July. Objective: curbing the increase in health costs in the outpatient field. A measure that will also serve to reduce prizes? And what will change for patients? Will they have to wait months before having an appointment with a specialist? And then there are the two popular initiatives on the vote on Sunday. They aim to reduce the prizes on citizens. Proposals rejected by the Council of State, which considers them unsustainable for cantonal finances. But then you have to introduce corrections or rethink the system? Tell us your experiences. In the studio to answer your doubts and concerns there will be the main actors in the health sector. / Che sofferenza! di Federica Bonetti, Camilla Contarini, Olmo Invernizzi, Aron Anselmi Nuova impennata dei premi di cassa malati. +4.4% in Svizzera, +7.1% in Ticino, lincremento cantonale più doloroso Un altro aumento. Il quarto consecutivo. Il prossimo anno il premio medio mensile per lassicurazione obbligatoria di base sarà in Ticino di 501.50 franchi, contro i 393.30 franchi in Svizzera e i 347.50 nei Grigioni, che segnano un rincaro del 5.5%. Il Ticino è il cantone con il premio e lincremento nettamente più elevato di tutta la Svizzera. Per i cittadini unaltra mazzata che peserà ulteriormente sul budget famigliare. Anche perche il premio era già aumentato del 9.2% nel 2023 e del 10.5% nel 2024 e nel 2025. Ma quanto incidono questi salassi? A cosa devono rinunciare gli assicurati per far quadrare i conti e arrivare alla fine del mese? Ci sono ricette per risparmiare? Patti chiari ha raccolto le testimonianze di chi in poco tempo sè visto lievitare la fattura annuale di oltre 1000 franchi. Eppure, per spendere meno, ha scelto la franchigia più alta, quella da 2500 franchi. Fino a questo importo paga quindi di tasca propria eventuali visite e medicamenti. Eventuali. Perche cè anche chi non ha o non vuole spendere 2500 franchi, e anche meno. "Vado dal medico solo nel caso sia moribondo" ci ha detto un assicurato. Rimandare o rinunciare ad esami e consulti è sempre più frequente. Con quali conseguenze? E poi cè chi, per risparmiare, va in Italia, anche solo per un controllo del sangue. E il cosiddetto turismo sanitario. Insomma la pressione dei premi è alle stelle. E i cittadini chiedono alla politica soluzioni. Una di queste è la moratoria sullapertura di studi medici in 8 specializzazioni, entrata in vigore lo scorso 1 luglio. Obbiettivo: frenare laumento dei costi della salute in ambito ambulatoriale. Una misura che servirà anche a ridurre i premi? E per i pazienti cosa cambierà? Dovranno aspettare mesi prima di avere un appuntamento con uno specialista? E poi ci sono le due iniziative popolari in votazione domenica. Mirano a ridurre limpatto dei premi sui cittadini. Proposte bocciate dal Consiglio di Stato, che le ritiene insostenibili per le finanze cantonali. Ma allora bisogna introdurre correttivi o ripensare il sistema? Raccontateci le vostre esperienze. Once upon a time, the Superior - thread, hope and his daughter Aurora - were friends of Guy's parents and in secret they hope to be able to separate him from the Croods and promote long with Aurora. / Nel suo viaggio solitario verso il Domani, Guy è stato accolto dai cavernicoli Croode e si è legato alla figlia, Hip, nonostante liniziale ritrosia del capofamiglia Grug. Alla ricerca di un luogo sicuro in cui vivere, Grug scopre un giardino segreto in cui vive la famiglia Superior che appartiene a una specie umana evoluta. Un tempo i Superior - Filo, Speranza e la figlia Aurora - erano amici dei genitori di Guy e in gran segreto sperano di riuscire a separarlo dai Croods e favorirne lunione con Aurora.

programme.title: Segni dei tempi
programme.desc: We enter the world of photography through the eyes of a man who in Malcantone has bridge between German Switzerland and Ticino, between Protestantism and the Catholic world. An opportunity to rediscover the work of Eugenio Schmidhauser who innovated the imagination of Ticino in the early twentieth century. A photographic production his capable of moving in a cultural environment in which borders came to fall. Between the Appenzello and Bavaria, between Ticino and Europe, between reality and caricature. / Entriamo nel mondo della fotografia attraverso gli occhi di un uomo che nel Malcantone fece da ponte fra Svizzera tedesca e Ticino, fra protestantesimo e mondo cattolico. Un’occasione per riscoprire il lavoro di Eugenio Schmidhauser che innovò l’immaginario del Ticino di inizio Novecento. Una produzione fotografica la sua capace di muoversi in un ambiente culturale in cui venivano a cadere le frontiere. Tra l’Appenzello e la Baviera, tra il Ticino e l’Europa, tra la realtà e la caricatura.

programme.title: Dantes Peak - The mountain fury / Dantes Peak - La furia della montagna
programme.desc: Harry Dalton and a volcanologist sent by his boss at the town of Dantes Peak that stands at the foot of a dormant volcano. After conducting some surveys, he realizes that the mountain could erupt and suggests the lever of the city. But the authorities do not agree with Harry and citizenship is not warned. Suddenly the mountain begins with a leaning and panic spreads. / Harry Dalton e un vulcanologo inviato dal suo capo presso la cittadina di Dantes Peak che sorge ai piedi di un vulcano dormiente. Dopo aver condotto alcune rilevazioni si accorge che la montagna potrebbe eruttare e suggerisce levacuazione della citta. Ma le autorita non concordano con Harry e la cittadinanza non viene avvisata. Improvvisamente la montagna inizia leruzione e si diffonde il panico.

programme.title: Albert's garden - Strapped animals / Il giardino di Albert - Animali da sballo
programme.desc: Ernst Von Bibra, MordaCai Cubitt Cooke, Paolo Mantegazza ... are some of the first scientists in Europe to deal with drugs. We are about the mid -nineteenth century and everyone - in a way or in the Love - senses the luniversality and lyricist of this human behavior and the limitation of studying it following a scientific approach. However, almost nobody still goes up to embrace the animal world. One of the few to do so is the Lombard Paolo Mantegazza in a work written in 1871. But there are only two pages on more than a thousand. Starting from the twentieth century, however, science begins to pay more attention to the relationship between animal world and psychoactive substances. Today we have a very large corpus of studies and research. However, many aspects on the consumption of drugs by animals are still dark and the subject of debate. In this episode of the Albertian garden Christian Bernasconi it will take us from Finland to South Africa to discover some living beings who between a pouring and a hallucinogenic high question us about our relationship with drugs. Beyond the certainly fun anecdotes, today's documentary helps us to understand the complex phenomenon that leads us to take drugs. From occasional pleasure, to addiction with lethal outcomes. / Ernst von Bibra, Mordecai Cubitt Cooke, Paolo Mantegazza ... sono alcuni fra i primi scienziati in Europa a occuparsi di droghe. Siamo circa a metà del XIX secolo e tutti - in un modo o nellaltro - intuiscono luniversalità e lineluttabilità di questo comportamento umano e limportanza di studiarlo seguendo un approccio scientifico. Quasi nessuno però ancora si spinge fino ad abbracciare il mondo animale. Uno dei pochi a farlo è il lombardo Paolo Mantegazza in unopera scritta nel 1871. Ma sono soltanto due pagine su più di mille. A partire dal XX secolo la scienza inizia però a prestare più attenzione alla relazione tra mondo animale e sostanze psicoattive. Oggi disponiamo di un corpus di studi e ricerche assai vasto. Tuttavia, moltissimi aspetti sul consumo di droghe da parte degli animali sono ancora oscuri e oggetto di dibattito. In questa puntata del giardino di Albert Christian Bernasconi ci porterà dalla Finlandia fino al Sudafrica alla scoperta di alcuni esseri viventi che tra una sbronza e uno sballo allucinogeno ci interrogano sul nostro rapporto con le sostanze stupefacenti. Al di là degli aneddoti certamente divertenti, il documentario di oggi ci aiuta a capire il complesso fenomeno che ci porta ad assumere droghe. Dal piacere occasionale, fino alla dipendenza con esiti letali.

programme.title: Segni
programme.sub-title: Musica accessibile allEurovision Song Contest in Svizzera
programme.desc: The Eurovision Song Contest is a huge musical event involving 37 countries. In 2025 he was organized in Basel, given that Nemo, an artist who represented Switzerland, won last year's edition. Segni has dedicated an episode to this event and Natascha Ruf makes us discover how deaf people can use it. The Eurovision Song Contest was made accessible with initiatives both for the public who watched the show on television and for those who were on site. For example, the songs in competition were translated for the first time in Switzerland in the language of the international signs, as well as the live broadcast was translated into the three languages ​​of the national signs. The team of deaf translators and translators explain to Natasha the methods adopted to return not only the text in ISL, but also the emotions and the rhythm of the songs. In the Eurovision Song Contest village, an inclusive disco was used, whose floor pulsates to the rhythm of music. In this way, deaf people were able to perceive the vibrations of the songs and participate in all respects in fun. Natasha Ruf accompanies us to discover an opportunity for enrichment for everyone, sealed with music and the pleasure of sharing ... / L’Eurovision Song Contest è un enorme evento musicale che coinvolge 37 Paesi. Nel 2025 è stato organizzato a Basilea, dato che Nemo, artista che rappresentava la Svizzera, ha vinto l’edizione dello scorso anno. SEGNI ha dedicato una puntata a questa manifestazione e Natascha Ruf ci fa scoprire in che modo le persone sorde possono fruirne. L’Eurovision Song Contest è stato reso accessibile con delle iniziative sia per il pubblico che guardava lo spettacolo in televisione sia per coloro che erano presenti in loco. Ad esempio, i brani in concorso sono stati tradotti per la prima volta in Svizzera in lingua dei segni internazionale, così come la diretta è stata tradotta nelle tre lingue dei segni nazionali. La squadra di traduttrici e traduttori sordi spiegano a Natasha le modalità adottate per restituire in ISL non solo il testo, ma anche le emozioni e il ritmo delle canzoni. Nel villaggio dell’Eurovision Song Contest è stata adibita una discoteca inclusiva, il cui pavimento pulsa a ritmo di musica. In questo modo le persone sorde hanno potuto percepire le vibrazioni delle canzoni e partecipare a tutti gli effetti al divertimento. Natasha Ruf ci accompagna alla scoperta di un’opportunità di arricchimento per tutti, suggellata della musica e dal piacere di condividere…

programme.title: Paganini
programme.desc: Just in these days, sixty years ago, one of the fundamental pages of international pop rock was written: on May 12, 1965 at the RCA Studios of Hollywood I Rolling Stones recorded the single (I Cant Get No) Satisfaction which would be published in the United States on June 6, 1965, quickly leaping at the head of the Billboard Hot 100. Keith Richards who in one one cleared cleared up to the top of the rankings the most acidic distortions and proclaimed the British Invasion as a cultural and social phenomenon of global scope. Paganini has chosen to dedicate the episode of Sunday 18 May to this anniversary - from 10.30 on RSI LA1 - however, facing it indirectly: first of all commissioning the Balkan Lovers group a new version of (I Cant Get No) Satiscation, transposing it from the era and gender to affirm its symbolic and transversal cultural value. The second reference to the Stones is given by the documentary Catching Fire, the story of Alexis Bloom and Svetlana Zill's Anita Playergg. Model, actress and icon of style, Anita Palenberg was linked to the Rolling Stones both by the heart issues (girlfriend first of Brian Jones and then Keith Richards, from whom she had three children) both from artistic aspects, acting as a real muse and inspiring for the group's lestetic. The film is based on the autobiography of the Palenberg - entitled Black Magic - which remained unpublished and found by the children after his death in 2017. For this reason, the intimate and posthumous reading of the pages of the diary was entrusted to the voice of Scarlett Johansson. - Catching Fire, the story of Anita Playlenberg - (I Cant Get no) Satiscation / Proprio in questi giorni, sessantanni fa, si scriveva una delle pagine fondamentali del pop rock internazionale: il 12 maggio 1965 agli RCA Studios di Hollywood i Rolling Stones registravano infatti il singolo (I cant get no) Satisfaction che sarebbe stato pubblicato negli Stati Uniti il 6 giugno 1965, balzando rapidamente in testa alla Billboard Hot 100. Si trattò del primo grande successo del gruppo di Mick Jagger e Keith Richards che in un sol colpo sdoganava in cima alle classifiche le distorsioni più acide e proclamava la British invasion come un fenomeno culturale e sociale di portata globale. Paganini ha scelto di dedicare a questo anniversario la puntata di domenica 18 maggio - dalle 10.30 su RSI LA1 - affrontandolo però indirettamente: innanzitutto commissionando al gruppo Balkan Lovers una nuova versione di (I cant get no) Satisfaction, trasponendola di epoca e di genere per affermarne il valore culturale simbolico e trasversale. Il secondo riferimento agli Stones è dato dal documentario Catching Fire, la storia di Anita Pallenberg di Alexis Bloom e Svetlana Zill. Modella, attrice e icona di stile, Anita Pallenberg fu legata ai Rolling Stones sia da questioni di cuore (fidanzata prima di Brian Jones e poi di Keith Richards, da cui ebbe tre figli) sia da aspetti artistici, fungendo da vera e propria musa e ispiratrice per lestetica del gruppo. Il film è basato sullautobiografia della Pallenberg - intitolata Black Magic - rimasta inedita e ritrovata dai figli dopo la sua morte nel 2017. Per questo, la lettura intima e postuma delle pagine del diario è stata affidata alla voce di Scarlett Johansson. - Catching Fire, la storia di Anita Pallenberg - (I Cant Get No) Satisfaction

programme.desc: The lady in yellow (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American yellow show, with the participation of Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. He aired weekly on the CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV-Movie, until 2003 (as a wagon read with murder, the ballad of the lost boy and appointment with death). Angela Lansbury played the role of executive producer of the show in his last seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspective writer of yellow, who often finds himself dealing with mysterious murders, for whom he always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small village, the fictitious Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of La Signora in Yellow is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the first choice of the manufacturer. The part had been initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however refused. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

programme.title: Sottosopra
programme.desc: Climb Me Tender by Nicolò Mariani an unusual and captivating portrait of one of the strongest interpreters of the Bouldering practice. On the granite blocks of Ticino, Giuliano Cameroni reveals his most artistic side, in a vertical dance in search of harmony and aesthetics of the movement. In the surroundings of the wild of Fulvio and Nicolò Mariani "Il Selvaggio Blu" is a path that overlooks the steep cliffs of the Supramonte di Baunei in Sardinia. It is considered one of the most beautiful and demanding itineraries in the Mediterranean. To accompany its creator, the Florentine photographer Mario Verin, the Sardinian hiking guide Antonio Cabras and two guests of our house ... Relitti by Claudio Gazzaroli Carlo Terni is a passionate diving and in his free time, fascinated by the history of the first and Second World War, CA begins 20 years ago to explore the seabed in front of Tuscany. In this area where his finds did. Over the years Carlo has gained an incredible experience, so much so that, he has already found thirty wrecks. In his portfolio of finds a hunting bomber P38 stands out, the only one found in Italy, still intact and in flight structure. All episodes can be revised on the Play RSI. A production by Fulvio and Nicolò Mariani. / Climb me tender di Nicolò Mariani Un inconsueto ed accattivante ritratto di uno dei più forti interpreti della pratica del Bouldering. Sui blocchi di granito del Ticino, Giuliano Cameroni ci svela il suo lato più artistico, in una danza verticale alla ricerca dell’armonia e dell’estetica del movimento. Nei dintorni del Selvaggio di Fulvio e Nicolò Mariani “Il Selvaggio Blu” è un percorso che si affaccia sulle ripide scogliere del Supramonte di Baunei in Sardegna. È considerato uno degli itinerari più belli e impegnativi del Mediterraneo. Ad accompagnarci il suo ideatore, il fotografo fiorentino Mario Verin, la guida escursionistica sarda Antonio Cabras e due ospiti di casa nostra... Relitti di Claudio Gazzaroli Carlo Terni è un appassionato subacqueo e nel suo tempo libero, affascinato dalla storia della prima e seconda guerra mondiale, inizia ca. 20 anni or sono ad esplorare i fondali di fronte alla Toscana. In questa zona dove ha fatto i suoi ritrovamenti. Carlo, nel corso degli anni ha maturato un esperienza incredibile, tanto che, ha già trovato una trentina di relitti. Nel suo portfolio di ritrovamenti spicca un caccia bombardiere P38, l’unico ritrovato in Italia, ancora intatto e in assetto di volo. Tutte le puntate possono essere riviste sul Play RSI. Una produzione di Fulvio e Nicolò Mariani.

programme.title: Io and Marilyn
programme.desc: Gualtiero is involved by friends in a spirit session that evokes the spirit of Marylin Monroe. And here Gualtiero finds himself at home Licona world of sensuality and femininity. But there is a problem: only he manages to see her and speak to her. Luckily Arnolfo, already an expert in the spirits sector and roars, helps him not to feel crazy, confiding on him, for example, having had at home for 40 days nothing less than Hitler. Marilyn thus becomes Gualtiero's personal consultant and helps him to solve love trouble and personal tragedies. In fact, Luomo has an ex -wife, Ramona, who left him to go to live in a circus with Pasquale, a Neapolitan tamer. Ramona brought his daughter he had from Gualtiero to live in the circus: Martina. programme.title: Window to Sunday - magazine / FENSTER ZUM SONNTAG – Magazin
programme.desc: Switzerland with its numerous peaks, its sunny hanging and sometimes deep, shady valley stands metaphorically for the fates of the people who live in it. Only the different experiences - whether positively or negative - fragments and forms to us humans that we finally become. Michael Welz lives high up above Davos from June to September. Up here in the beautiful landscape, he feels at home, although he has only been doing work as a mininger for six years. Because actually his farm is somewhere else, namely in the lowlands, in Oberembrach ZH. But now his wife Tabea and he have leased the alp. With this, an old dream is fulfilled for Michael, because even as a child he was often on the Alp in summer to help. But life and working on the Alp is not as idyllic as you imagine. The work is often muzzen, the way is wide and the Wolf Michael headzes. One of his cows was attacked and tasted. If a pack is settled here, his herd is acute in danger. Reto Salzmann's life story is in the truest sense. Even as a child, he experiences domestic violence. Only when he comes to a foster family at the age of five does his life seem to go up. However, this is only of short duration. His first wife falls ill with a death illness and after her death Reto is on his own with the children. He might put an end to his life, but a little stop. Shortly afterwards, Reto meets his today's wife Monika. Finally calm returns until he falls ill to Long Covid in 2021 and admitted to a rehab clinic, where he stays for several months. Although he then loses his job, Reto has never lost the courage to look positively into the future. Today he even got to his dream job through all the desks in his life. / Die Schweiz mit ihren zahlreichen Gipfeln, ihren sonnigen Hangen und teils tiefen, schattigen Talern steht metaphorisch fur die Schicksale der Menschen, die in ihr wohnen. Erst die unterschiedlichen Erfahrungen – ob positiv oder negativ – pragen und formen uns Menschen zu den Personlichkeiten, die wir schliesslich werden.Michael Welz lebt von Juni bis September hoch oben uber Davos auf der Alp. Hier oben in der wunderschonen Landschaft fuhlt er sich zuhause, obwohl er erst seit sechs Jahren die Arbeit als Bergbauer verrichtet. Denn eigentlich liegt sein Hof ganz woanders, namlich im Unterland, in Oberembrach ZH. Doch nun haben seine Frau Tabea und er die Alp dazu gepachtet. Damit erfullt sich fur Michael ein alter Traum, denn bereits als Kind war er im Sommer oft auf der Alp, um zu helfen. Doch das Leben und Arbeiten auf der Alp ist nicht so idyllisch, wie man es sich vorstellt. Die Arbeit ist oft muhsam, die Wege weit und aktuell bereitet der Wolf Michael Kopfzerbrechen. Eine seiner Kuhe wurde angefallen und getotet. Sollte sich ein Rudel hier niederlassen ist seine Herde akut in Gefahr.Reto Salzmanns Lebensgeschichte ist im wahrsten Sinne ein Auf und Ab. Bereits als Kind erlebt er hausliche Gewalt. Erst als er im Alter von funf Jahren zu einer Pflegefamilie kommt, scheint sein Leben aufwartszugehen. Dies ist aber nur von kurzer Dauer. Seine erste Frau erkrankt an einer todlichen Krankheit und nach ihrem Tod ist Reto mit den gemeinsamen Kindern auf sich allein gestellt. Er mochte seinem Leben ein Ende setzen, doch etwas halt ihn zuruck. Kurz danach lernt Reto seine heutige Frau Monika kennen. Endlich kehrt Ruhe ein, bis er 2021 an Long Covid erkrankt und in eine Reha Klinik eingeliefert wird, wo er mehrere Monate bleibt. Obwohl er anschliessend seine Arbeitsstelle verliert, hat Reto nie den Mut verloren, positiv in die Zukunft zu blicken. Heute ist er durch all die Talfahrten in seinem Leben sogar zu seinem Traumberuf gelangt.

programme.title: Einstein
programme.sub-title: Bitcoin, Twint or E-Franconia: What is the money of the future? / Bitcoin, Twint oder E-Franken: Was ist das Geld der Zukunft?
programme.desc: On the way to cashless social allowance, there is on the right. Corona pandemic has the trend towards cashless shopping. In the meantime, many even pay the chewing gum in the kiosk or the gem on the market by card or app. Is that why Switzerland is on the way to a cashless society? And what does it mean when grades and municipality disappear more and more? To answer these questions, researchers focus on Scandinavia. Cash as a means of payment has disappeared practically. This changed social bonds and increases the risk of debt. The majority of the problem: Pay electronically without leaving a data track is not yet possible. Digital money that you can spend anonymous and directly like cash would therefore be of great advantage. Some rely on the blockchain. The technology behind crypto food, such as Bitcoin. The Bernese computer science professor Christian Grothoff goes a different way. Thanks to the payment system GNU Taler, which he has developed, you can load the digital copy of a protection on the mobile phone. Soon in Basel you can pay completely anonymously with digital local food. The Swiss National Bank, on the other hand, is still looking out in terms of E-money. There will be no digital franc for the broad population in the near future. The future of money “Einstein” wants to find out how and, above all, with what courses should be paid out. Together with the cash organic and Podcaster Fabio Canetg, moderator Tobias Muller is making a journey to the “Bank of the Future” from the Bundesplatz - under which Switzerland's gold reserves are supposed to be. And learn that the money of the future is less about grades and Munich, all the more about trust. / Auf dem Weg zur bargeldlosen GesellschaftBargeld ist auf dem Ruckzug. Die Corona-Pandemie hat den Trend zum bargeldlosen Einkaufen noch verstarkt. Mittlerweile zahlen viele sogar den Kaugummi im Kiosk oder das Gemuse auf dem Markt per Karte oder App. Befindet sich die Schweiz deshalb auf dem Weg in eine bargeldlose Gesellschaft? Und was bedeutet es, wenn Noten und Munzen immer mehr verschwinden?Um diese Fragen zu beantworten, richten Forschende ihren Blick auf Skandinavien. Dort ist Bargeld als Zahlungsmittel praktisch verschwunden. Soziale Bindungen haben sich dadurch verandert und die Gefahr der Verschuldung steigt. Das grosste Problem: Elektronisch zahlen, ohne eine Datenspur zu hinterlassen, ist zurzeit noch nicht moglich. Digitales Geld, dass man wie Bargeld anonym und direkt ausgeben kann, ware deshalb von grossem Vorteil.Das Rennen um den E-FrankenGleich mehrere Organisationen versuchen momentan, einen Digitalfranken zu schaffen. Einige setzen dabei auf die Blockchain. Die Technologie hinter Kryptowahrungen, wie dem Bitcoin. Einen anderen Weg geht der Berner Informatikprofessor Christian Grothoff. Dank dem Bezahlsystem GNU Taler, das er mitentwickelt hat, kann man sich die digitale Kopie einer Wahrung aufs Mobiltelefon laden. Bald soll man in Basel so mit einer digitalen Lokalwahrung komplett anonym bezahlen konnen. Noch zuruckhaltend in Sachen E-Geld ist dagegen die Schweizerische Nationalbank. Einen digitalen Franken fur die breite Bevolkerung wird es von der SNB in naher Zukunft nicht geben.Die Zukunft des Geldes«Einstein» will herausfinden, wie und vor allem mit welchen Wahrungen kunftig bezahlt werden soll. Gemeinsam mit dem Geldokonomen und Podcaster Fabio Canetg unternimmt Moderator Tobias Muller eine Reise, die ihn vom Bundesplatz – unter dem die Goldreserven der Schweiz liegen sollen – in die «Bank der Zukunft» fuhrt. Und erfahrt, dass es beim Geld der Zukunft weniger um Noten und Munzen geht, dafur umso mehr um Vertrauen.

programme.title: SRF bi de Lut
programme.desc: Two years ago, his left toe stuck in the spines of the most poisonous fish in Europe, in Petermann. Today Philipp Kunz from Munchenstein BL was spared on this species and serves it to his four colleagues - to the main course of notaing. You can of course get the Petermannchen served without the poisonous backstreams, so garnished with memories of the painful bathing holidays in France. Philipp Kunz is the ambitious in the team. Only a kase plate or a piece of meat that the guest still has to fry as an imposition does not come on the table with him. Self-Made is his motto, and the project manager of a telecommunications company comes up with a lot: be it the light curry lemon grass soup next to the Tatar from Bundnerfleisch, the Cicorino-Rosseo risotto, the rosemary parfait or the homemade Florentine. With the intent "The winner I am", the 46-year Basel bidder stands to the stove-well prepared with all its notes and drawings. Is it really noted on that? An ambitious hobby chef is portrayed: a “Basler Bebbi”, as it is in the textbook, Fasnachtler and FCB fan. All peace, joy, pancakes, you could think. If there was no diagnosis of multiple sclerosis that Philipp Kunz received six years ago. However, he cannot get it down by the disease. / Vor zwolf Jahren steckte seine linke Zehe in den Stacheln des giftigsten Fisches Europas, im Petermannchen. Heute nun ubt Philipp Kunz aus Munchenstein BL verspatete Rache an dieser Spezies und serviert sie seinen vier Mitstreitern – zum Hauptgang notabene. Aufgetischt bekommen sie die Petermannchen naturlich ohne die giftigen Ruckenstacheln, dafur garniert mit Erinnerungen an die schmerzhaften Badeferien in Frankreich.Philipp Kunz ist der Ehrgeizige im Team. Nur eine Kaseplatte oder ein Stuck Fleisch, das der Gast als Zumutung noch selber braten muss, kommen bei ihm nicht auf den Tisch. Self-made ist seine Devise, und da lasst sich der Projektleiter eines Telekommunikationsunternehmens so einiges einfallen: Sei es die leichte Curry-Zitronengras-Suppe neben dem Tatar aus Bundnerfleisch, das Cicorino-rosso-Risotto, das Rosmarin-Parfait oder die hausgemachten Florentiner. Mit dem Vorsatz «Der Gewinner bin ich» stellt sich der 46-jahrige Baselbieter an den Herd – gut vorbereitet mit all seinen Notizen und Zeichnungen. Ist darauf aber auch wirklich alles notiert?Die vierte Folge von «SRF bi de Lut - Mannerkuche» wird es zeigen. Portratiert wird ein ambitionierter Hobbykoch: ein «Basler Bebbi», wie er im Lehrbuch steht, Fasnachtler und FCB-Fan. Alles Friede, Freude, Eierkuchen, konnte man meinen. Wenn da nicht die Diagnose Multiple Sklerose ware, die Philipp Kunz vor sechs Jahren erhielt. Unterkriegen jedoch lasst er sich durch die Krankheit nicht.

programme.desc: During the two large islands of Rømø and Fanø with their almost endless strands are very sought-after holiday destinations, Mandø is a rather tranquil mini-rank. Once a year, a car racing with so -called Hotrods is held on the beach in Rømø, fried classic cars until the year of construction 1947. The Mandø flood cuts off the mainland twice a day. In order to get to the island, the Nielsen family transports people and freight over a narrow gravel dam with their tractors and double-decker attackers. Jens Møller Jensen is the only policeman on the island of Rømø. He has the political station directly in his own house, including individual cell. Jensen's "main crime scene" is the huge beach: driving there is allowed, but not spending the night in campers and motorhomes. / Wahrend die beiden groSSen Inseln Rømø und Fanø mit ihren schier endlosen Stranden stark gefragte Urlaubsziele sind, ist Mandø ein eher beschauliches Mini-Eiland. Einmal im Jahr wird am Strand von Rømø ein Autorennen mit sogenannten Hotrods ausgetragen, frisierten Oldtimern bis Baujahr 1947. Zweimal am Tag schneidet das Hochwasser Mandø vom Festland ab. Um auf die Insel zu kommen, transportiert Familie Nielsen mit ihren Traktoren und Doppeldecker-Personen-Anhangern die Menschen und Fracht uber einen schmalen, vom Wasser uberspulten Schotterdamm. Jens Møller Jensen ist der einzige Polizist auf der Insel Rømø. Die Politi-Station hat er direkt im eigenen Haus, inklusive Einzelzelle. Jensens "Haupttatort" ist der riesige Strand: Dort ist zwar das Befahren erlaubt, aber nicht das Übernachten in Campern und Wohnmobilen.

programme.title: Knochenjobs
programme.sub-title: With wood and steel / Mit Holz und Stahl
programme.desc: A port ride is modernized in a Hamburg shipyard. The ship was completely gutted for this. Half a year should remain the ride in the shipyard, then it should go back to the Elbe. The shipbuilders Melvin Ommer and Torben Groth reintegrate the general car. Not so easy. The huge component weighs 1.5 tons and the machine room is tight. / In einer Hamburger Werft wird eine Hafenfahre modernisiert. Das Schiff wurde dafur komplett entkernt. Ein halbes Jahr soll die Fahre in der Werft bleiben, dann soll sie wieder auf die Elbe. Die Schiffsbauer Melvin Ommer und Torben Groth bauen die generaluberholte Antriebsmaschine wieder ein. Gar nicht so einfach. Das riesige Bauteil wiegt 1,5 Tonnen und der Maschinenraum ist eng.

programme.title: Profis am Limit
programme.desc: A crew of seafarers must guarantee that the Sankt Lorenz stream can also be accessed by large ships at all times. Therefore, the depth of the current must be checked non -stop and the reason for whose reason is dredged in places with large deposits. Another crew of maintenance professionals must have a 400-passenger driving general. / Eine Crew von Seeleuten muss garantieren, dass der Sankt-Lorenz-Strom jederzeit auch von groSSen Schiffen befahrbar ist. Deshalb muss die Tiefe des Stromes nonstop uberpruft werden und dessen Grund an Stellen mit groSSen Ablagerungen ausgebaggert werden. Eine weitere Besatzung der Wartungs-Profis muss eine 400-Passagier-Fahre generaluberholen.

programme.title: Kenia - Uganda - Rwanda / Kenia – Uganda – Ruanda
programme.sub-title: With Franco Marvulli to the Rad World Cup in Africa / Mit Franco Marvulli an die Rad-WM in Afrika
programme.desc: From September 21 to 28, 2025, the World Cup Championships will take place in the Rwandan capital Kigali. For the first time, the global title struggles on the African continent go over the gray. Franco Marvulli uses this opportunity to cycle through East Africa with his bike. With the bike, the four-time railway bike world champion from Kenya Uber Uganda travels to Rwanda to the 2025 bike, thunderstorm, high and traffic, Marvullisrf accompanied the 46-year on his sporting adventure. The result is a four -part documentary with surprising encounters and a fresh look at the growing bike scene in Africa - and this shows: Marvulli, notabene proud owner of an Olympic silver medal, reaches his body and mental limits on his way to Kigali. The Zurcher must leave its comfort zone and get involved with the incorrectness of the African streets. The route leads him through the city and village, over swampy slopes, shaky broods and steep climbs into the miracle of nature of East Africa. Heat, thunderstorms, high and traffic demand Marvulli and his fellow campaigners - as well as breakdowns, Grenzuberritten and the constant struggle against mudness. Mechanics with improvisation geistimity Center of the film are on site: drivers local clubs, mechanics with improvisation, hosts, young talents. The camera remains curious and respectful, shows bike culture on market routes, in workshops and on school paths. Marvulli reflects motivation, doubts and security: What really brings you to your goal? In Kigali, the film arranges the journey around the World Championships. This creates an honest road movie about perseverance and exchange - and about how bike ride can build Brucken. The documentation is broadcast as part of the two World Cup road races on Saturday, September 27, 2025, from 6.30 p.m. (parts 1 and 2) and on Sunday, September 28, at 11.10 a.m. (part 3) or 5:05 p.m. (part 4). / Vom 21. bis 28. September 2025 finden in der ruandischen Hauptstadt Kigali die Rad-Weltmeisterschaften auf der Strasse statt. Zum ersten Mal uberhaupt gehen die globalen Titelkampfe auf dem afrikanischen Kontinent uber die Buhne. Franco Marvulli nutzt diese Gelegenheit, um mit seinem Velo durch Ostafrika zu radeln. Mit dem Velo reist der vierfache Bahnrad-Weltmeister von Kenia uber Uganda nach Ruanda an die Rad-WM 2025.Hitze, Gewitter, Hohe und Verkehr fordern MarvulliSRF hat den 46-Jahrigen auf seinem sportlichen Abenteuer begleitet. Herausgekommen ist eine vierteilige Dokumentation mit uberraschenden Begegnungen und einem frischen Blick auf die wachsende Veloszene in Afrika – und die zeigt: Marvulli, notabene stolzer Besitzer einer olympischen Silbermedaille, kommt auf seinem Weg nach Kigali an seine korperlichen und mentalen Grenzen. Der Zurcher muss seine Komfortzone verlassen und sich auf die Unwagbarkeiten der afrikanischen Strassen einlassen. Die Route fuhrt ihn durch Stadte und Dorfer, uber sumpfige Pisten, wacklige Brucken und steile Anstiege in die wunderschone Natur Ostafrikas. Hitze, Gewitter, Hohe und Verkehr fordern Marvulli und seine Mitstreiter – ebenso Pannen, Grenzubertritte und der stete Kampf gegen die Mudigkeit.Mechaniker mit ImprovisationsgeistIm Zentrum des Films stehen die Menschen vor Ort: Fahrer lokaler Clubs, Mechaniker mit Improvisationsgeist, Gastgeberinnen, junge Talente. Die Kamera bleibt neugierig und respektvoll, zeigt Velokultur auf Marktstrassen, in Werkstatten und auf Schulwegen. Marvulli reflektiert Motivation, Zweifel und Sicherheit: Was bringt einen wirklich ans Ziel? In Kigali ordnet der Film die Reise im Umfeld der Weltmeisterschaften ein. So entsteht ein ehrliches Roadmovie uber Ausdauer und Austausch – und daruber, wie das Velofahren Brucken bauen kann. Ausgestrahlt wird die Dokumentation im Rahmen der beiden WM-Strassenrennen am Samstag, 27. September 2025, ab 18.30 Uhr (Teile 1 und 2) sowie am Sonntag, 28. September, um 11.10 Uhr (Teil 3) respektive 17.05 Uhr (Teil 4).

programme.title: Window to Sunday - magazine / FENSTER ZUM SONNTAG – Magazin
programme.desc: Switzerland with its numerous peaks, its sunny hanging and sometimes deep, shady valley stands metaphorically for the fates of the people who live in it. Only the different experiences - whether positively or negative - fragments and forms to us humans that we finally become. Michael Welz lives high up above Davos from June to September. Up here in the beautiful landscape, he feels at home, although he has only been doing work as a mininger for six years. Because actually his farm is somewhere else, namely in the lowlands, in Oberembrach ZH. But now his wife Tabea and he have leased the alp. With this, an old dream is fulfilled for Michael, because even as a child he was often on the Alp in summer to help. But life and working on the Alp is not as idyllic as you imagine. The work is often muzzen, the way is wide and the Wolf Michael headzes. One of his cows was attacked and tasted. If a pack is settled here, his herd is acute in danger. Reto Salzmann's life story is in the truest sense. Even as a child, he experiences domestic violence. Only when he comes to a foster family at the age of five does his life seem to go up. However, this is only of short duration. His first wife falls ill with a death illness and after her death Reto is on his own with the children. He might put an end to his life, but a little stop. Shortly afterwards, Reto meets his today's wife Monika. Finally calm returns until he falls ill to Long Covid in 2021 and admitted to a rehab clinic, where he stays for several months. Although he then loses his job, Reto has never lost the courage to look positively into the future. Today he even got to his dream job through all the desks in his life. / Die Schweiz mit ihren zahlreichen Gipfeln, ihren sonnigen Hangen und teils tiefen, schattigen Talern steht metaphorisch fur die Schicksale der Menschen, die in ihr wohnen. Erst die unterschiedlichen Erfahrungen – ob positiv oder negativ – pragen und formen uns Menschen zu den Personlichkeiten, die wir schliesslich werden.Michael Welz lebt von Juni bis September hoch oben uber Davos auf der Alp. Hier oben in der wunderschonen Landschaft fuhlt er sich zuhause, obwohl er erst seit sechs Jahren die Arbeit als Bergbauer verrichtet. Denn eigentlich liegt sein Hof ganz woanders, namlich im Unterland, in Oberembrach ZH. Doch nun haben seine Frau Tabea und er die Alp dazu gepachtet. Damit erfullt sich fur Michael ein alter Traum, denn bereits als Kind war er im Sommer oft auf der Alp, um zu helfen. Doch das Leben und Arbeiten auf der Alp ist nicht so idyllisch, wie man es sich vorstellt. Die Arbeit ist oft muhsam, die Wege weit und aktuell bereitet der Wolf Michael Kopfzerbrechen. Eine seiner Kuhe wurde angefallen und getotet. Sollte sich ein Rudel hier niederlassen ist seine Herde akut in Gefahr.Reto Salzmanns Lebensgeschichte ist im wahrsten Sinne ein Auf und Ab. Bereits als Kind erlebt er hausliche Gewalt. Erst als er im Alter von funf Jahren zu einer Pflegefamilie kommt, scheint sein Leben aufwartszugehen. Dies ist aber nur von kurzer Dauer. Seine erste Frau erkrankt an einer todlichen Krankheit und nach ihrem Tod ist Reto mit den gemeinsamen Kindern auf sich allein gestellt. Er mochte seinem Leben ein Ende setzen, doch etwas halt ihn zuruck. Kurz danach lernt Reto seine heutige Frau Monika kennen. Endlich kehrt Ruhe ein, bis er 2021 an Long Covid erkrankt und in eine Reha Klinik eingeliefert wird, wo er mehrere Monate bleibt. Obwohl er anschliessend seine Arbeitsstelle verliert, hat Reto nie den Mut verloren, positiv in die Zukunft zu blicken. Heute ist er durch all die Talfahrten in seinem Leben sogar zu seinem Traumberuf gelangt.
